requirements.rule: ANNUAL MINIMI: the minimi of the CCNL are updated every year from 1 January by the Commissione nazionale (Art. 38, ISTAT variation of the consumer prices); the bundle holds the table of 2026. From 1 January 2027 the amounts are those of 2026 until the 2027 table is published and added, so a 2027 run is not payable.
requirements.remediation: Add the minimi of 2027 set by the Commissione nazionale with their source, then remove this note.

requirements.rule: The INPS contributions of the tredicesima are paid on the hours of the year: INPS bands them on the paga oraria effettiva, which spreads the tredicesima over the hours, so the tredicesima run charges no INPS hours. The Cas.Sa.Colf contribution of Art. 54 c. 2 is charged on the contributable hours the run states, a tredicesima run too: no bundled source says whether the tredicesima carries hours of its own for it.
requirements.remediation: Source from the Cas.Sa.Colf rules whether the tredicesima carries contributable hours and set them for extra-month runs.

requirements.rule: SINGLE PERIOD 2026-01-01. Pre-2026 tranches out of scope. Post-2026 CCNL 2025-2028 tranches not yet modelled: +30 on BS convivente from Jan 2027, +15 from Jan 2028, +15 from Sep 2028 (other levels proportional — exact amounts require official ASSINDATCOLF/DOMINA table for those periods).
requirements.remediation: Add the 2027 and 2028 tranches from the official ASSINDATCOLF/DOMINA tables.
